name: Skechers Uruguay
description: Official online store of Skechers in Uruguay. Sells Skechers footwear for women, men and children, including walking, running, slip-in and casual lines. Delivers within Montevideo and to the interior, with store pickup.
description_es: Tienda online oficial de Skechers en Uruguay. Vende calzado Skechers para mujer, hombre y niños, incluyendo líneas de caminata, running, slip-in y casual. Entrega en Montevideo y el interior, con retiro en tienda.

ships_to.notes: Delivery by UES (48 or 72 business hours, same-day in Montevideo) and PQuick (Montevideo and metropolitan area), with an option for the interior, per the store's shipping page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Store pickup after about 3 business days; held 10 business days.

search.notes: The search page loads, but results did not appear in the HTML; they probably render with JavaScript.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Brand flagship on a Fenicio storefront. Product pages show size and color variants. Internal search is not verified by the probe.
